You have received an email from your foreign pen pal, Jack, who is traveling to Vietnam next month and is eager to experience a traditional cultural celebration. Write an informal letter to Jack.

In your letter, you should:
- Introduce a prominent traditional cultural festival in Vietnam and explain its historical significance
- Inform Jack about the exact celebration dates, venue, and how to travel there
- Highlight exciting cultural performances or traditional rituals he should witness, and confirm if you can accompany him

body.answer: I am genuinely thrilled to hear that you are planning to visit Vietnam next month! I would like to give you information on the Hung Kings' Temple Festival, one of our most important traditional celebrations.
body.example: Every year, thousands of Vietnamese families gather there to honor their ancestors and show deep respect for our national history.
body.frame: K. Mẫu câu Thân mật hay gặp + D. Provide Information
body.reason: This festival plays an essential role in helping people remember the Hung Kings, the founders of our nation, and lets visitors gain a deeper understanding of Vietnamese culture and tradition.
body.requirement: Introduce a prominent traditional cultural festival in Vietnam and explain its historical significance

body.answer: I would like to let you know that the main festival takes place from the 8th to the 10th day of the third lunar month (mid-April next month) at the Hung Temple area in Phu Tho Province.
body.example: We can catch a comfortable tourist coach from My Dinh Bus Station in Hanoi at 7 AM, and remember to pack light clothes and walking shoes because we will climb many stone steps.
body.frame: D. Provide Information + K. Mẫu câu Thân mật hay gặp
body.reason: Taking a highway coach from Hanoi is fast and convenient, taking only about 90 minutes to reach the festival site.
body.requirement: Inform Jack about exact celebration dates, venue, and how to travel there

body.answer: You certainly shouldn't miss the morning incense offering ritual and Xoan folk singing performances, and I am happy to tell you that I can take two days off to go with you.
body.example: We can watch the colorful procession up the mountain at 8 AM and try wrapping square Chung cakes together at the festival yard.
body.frame: K. Mẫu câu Thân mật hay gặp + D. Provide Information
body.reason: Watching live drum shows and tasting traditional cakes will broaden your mind, and having a local friend with you helps avoid unnecessary trouble with tickets or directions.
body.requirement: Highlight cultural performances or traditional rituals and confirm if you can accompany him

content:
